summary.text: Tara Luján, listed by Ballotpedia as Tara Lujan, is a Democratic state representative from District 48 who was appointed in 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously worked as human resources director in the office of the New Mexico Treasurer.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the legislature, Tara Luján worked as human resources director for the office of the New Mexico Treasurer, a job she resigned to take her seat.
Her professional experience also includes working as a campaign manager for U.S. Rep. Ben Ray Luján.

The Santa Fe County Commission appointed Luján to the House in July 2020 to replace Linda Trujillo, and the Santa Fe County Democratic Party's Central Committee chose her as the party's 2020 general election nominee in an August 15, 2020, vote.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Appropriations and Finance Committee, the Commerce and Economic Development Committee and the State Government, Elections and Indian Affairs Committee.
